lines: Penni... could we talk for a moment?
I know you've been getting closer to someone else. I don't want to tell you who you can spend time with.
I just... wasn't expecting it to hurt this much.

choices.text: You matter to me. I should have talked to you.
You're making a big deal out of nothing.
I need some time to think about this.

lines: I don't need you to promise something you can't. I just want to know where we stand.
I feel a little better now.
I wasn't asking you to stop seeing anyone.
I just wanted to be honest about how I felt.
We can talk when you're ready. I'd rather not pretend nothing happened.
